title: CoinDCX report shows Indian users moving to broader crypto portfolios in 2025
summary: CoinDCX’s Sumit Gupta said crypto is becoming a natural extension of traditional investing as Indian traders mature.

title: CZ’s YZi ramps up prediction market bet as Opinion claims 40% share
summary: The YZi Labs-backed “Opinion” prediction market logged $1.5 billion in weekly volume just weeks after launch, outpacing Kalshi and Polymarket as prediction markets boom.

title: Grayscale Chainlink ETF draws $41M on debut, but not ‘blockbuster’
summary: Analysts called the Chainlink ETF’s debut a “solid” launch, but the development has yet to attract enough liquidity to reverse the LINK token’s 39% decline over the past year.

title: Bitcoin Policy Institute calls for Samourai pardon as petition tops 3,200
summary: A Washington think tank and prominent Bitcoiners say jailing the Samourai Wallet developers for an “unlicensed money transmitter” conspiracy criminalizes non-custodial code.

title: Citadel causes uproar for urging SEC to regulate DeFi tokenized stocks
summary: Citadel Securities argued that DeFi platforms offering tokenized US stocks should be regulated under securities laws and not get exemptive relief from the SEC.

title: Bitcoin may see ‘relief bounce’ as stabilization signs emerge: Analysts
summary: Bitfinex says “extreme deleveraging” and other indicators as factors that could help Bitcoin hold its ground and potentially move higher.

title: Ledger says popular chip used on Solana phones vulnerable to unstoppable attack
summary: Ledger says it was able to gain “full and absolute control” over a smartphone by using electromagnetic pulses to take over its chip.

title: Connecticut orders Robinhood, Crypto.com, Kalshi to stop prediction markets
summary: Connecticut has sent cease and desist letters to Robinhood, Crypto.com and Kalshi, claiming the platforms' event contracts are unlicensed sports betting.

title: IREN stock rebounds following $3.6B debt and equity fundraising move
summary: IREN closed trading on Wednesday up nearly 7%, slightly recovering from a major drop on Tuesday after sharing plans for its latest capital raising effort.

title: Solana Mobile to roll out native token in January
summary: Solana Mobile says its SKR token, tied to its Seeker phone, will launch early next year, with a total supply of 10 billion tokens.
